source: 20 structures x 3 runs x 20 turns per method; zero-based structure_index; no model calls or resimulation

definitions.fixed_truncation: Counterfactual fixed cap; preserves all existing actions before stop and therefore replayable without model calls. Does not estimate a policy conditioned on a changed announced horizon.
definitions.stop_on_complete: First observed execution.board_complete or 20. Deployable only if an exact completion signal is allowed; configured but disabled in these runs.
definitions.board_unchanged_3: First 3 consecutive turns where execution.structure_after equals structure_before, or 20. Uses observable board states, not scores.
definitions.first_best: Earliest argmax score over all 20 turns, uses future target-derived scores: non-deployable hindsight diagnostic only.
definitions.incomplete_terminal_unchanged_rounds: Number of consecutive end-of-episode rounds whose board state did not change, conditional on incomplete final state. Excludes impossible-target conclusions from evidence for RL.
